en: The old city hazy with mist and rain
The cobblestone road, fresh and unevenly scattered

zh: 這悠閒的曲徑小巷，我不熟悉
這簡樸的紅瓦白牆，我不熟悉
這帶著葡萄牙節奏的歌聲， 我不熟悉
這吹自大西洋垂天的雲層， 我不熟悉
en: These leisurely winding lanes—unfamiliar to me
These simple red-tiled roofs and white walls—unfamiliar to me
This song carrying a Portuguese rhythm—unfamiliar to me
These clouds blown from the Atlantic, hanging over the sky—unfamiliar to me

zh: 你有你的曲巷，你的瓦牆
你有你的歌聲，你的雲層
en: Yes
You have your winding alley, your tiled wall
You have your song, your layer of clouds
In the depths of the vast, hazy years
In the far distance of mottled history

zh: 城廓氣勢古拙，牆垣斑駁
起伏的歷史，曖昧的往事
en: Up along the damp stone steps
Fine rain sparse, umbrella shadows blurred
Wherever the eye reaches, the four fields lie heavy and still
The city walls hold an ancient, rugged bearing, their ramparts mottled
Enduring on through the long, long stretch
History's rise and fall, the ambiguous past
The rock face stands sheer
Facing the clouded sky alone, wordless
As if
Waiting for a few lines of verse
A few strains of song
Awakening the silence of a thousand ages
Thus
The past drifts faint, its mood lingering on
Cloud layered upon cloud
Time and space interweave with time and space, only
Can today's footprints
Reclaiming a feeling long departed?
The flower path winds
Circling round the vine-covered stone wall
Green shade half-hides the white church
A baroque bell tower
Already vanished into
The dim yellow of twilight
This moment
Will there be a wandering monk
Walking out of the Middle Ages
With a body covered in travel's dust
Sitting with me in silence, waiting for the bell to toll?
Just like this, looking back
The old city's quiet ease
Classical gentleness
Past events interweave
Feelings drift with the clouds and mist
In late spring, in the mist and rain

points.zh:
Obidos 是葡萄牙古城，位於首都里斯本北方約九十公里。紀元前三百年就有腓尼基人在此居住，二千多年前，羅馬人在這𥚃築碉堡和設村落。第八世紀初，北非的摩爾人佔領了大部分的西班牙和葡萄牙地區，在Obidos 建造城堡和城牆。直到1148年，葡萄牙王國的第一任國王擊退摩爾人，結束了四百多年的穆斯林統治。1228年 Dona Isabel 皇后到訪 Obidos 古城，一見鐘情，國王 Diniz 一世為表愛意，贈送該城為結婚禮物，自此該城稱作「皇后城堡」。1441年10歲的國王阿凡索五世 Afoso V，迎娶8歲表妹伊莎貝爾 Isabella of Coimbra 公主，婚禮在 Santa Maria 敎堂舉行， 故Obidos 又有「白色婚禮之城」的稱謂。此古城曾經票選爲世界十大浪漫結婚聖地之一。
Obidos 濱臨大西洋，是迷失在時代𥚃的古城，是石塊堆砌城牆環繞中的一片寧靜世界，有「山谷中的珍珠」的美譽。高大城牆中的小城，摒絶市井車馬喧嘩，散放著中世紀的古風古調，童話般的清純迷幻。鵝卵石街巷蜿蜒交織，曲徑短牆繁花點綴。兩側錯落有致的房舍，以白牆紅瓦，海水般的藍和大地的土黃，構成小城的主色調，予人一份自然，純樸，簡約的悠閒和愉悅。漫步其間 ，隨心流覽，藝品店的巧思，牆面的彩色擺置，典雅的街燈，加上巧克力和草莓的酒香，自有一番遺世獨立的淡然心情。巷弄清幽而雋永，時有詩意和美學悄然迎面而來。Santa Maria 敎堂的白色牆面和鐘塔，巴洛克的雕飾，流散著古典的婉約幽雅。古城地形起伏，彎曲小路，像一節美的旋律，漫延至山嶺和城垣。登臨城牆，放眼四望，一邊是屋舍紅瓦平排，葡萄園青濛連天而去，另一邊是城牆婉轉并列，沒入雨烟如史册沉寂。徘徊蹀踱，不覺有 " 行到水窮處，坐看雲起時 " 的自足閒適。
points.en:
Obidos is an ancient Portuguese town located about ninety kilometers north of the capital, Lisbon. Phoenicians already lived here three hundred years before the Common Era, and more than two thousand years ago the Romans built fortifications and settlements here. In the early eighth century, Moors from North Africa occupied most of Spain and Portugal and built a castle and walls at Obidos. It was not until 1148 that the first king of the Kingdom of Portugal drove out the Moors, ending more than four hundred years of Muslim rule. In 1228, Queen Dona Isabel visited the ancient town of Obidos and fell in love with it at first sight; King Diniz I, to express his affection, gave her the town as a wedding gift, and from then on it was known as the 'Queen's Castle.' In 1441, the ten-year-old King Afonso V married his eight-year-old cousin, Princess Isabella of Coimbra, in a wedding held at the Church of Santa Maria, giving Obidos the further name 'City of the White Wedding.' This ancient town has been voted one of the world's ten most romantic wedding destinations.
Obidos sits on the Atlantic coast, an ancient town lost in time, a tranquil world enclosed by stone walls, known as the 'Pearl in the Valley.' The small town within its tall walls is set apart from the noise and bustle of everyday life, giving off an old medieval air and a fairy-tale-like purity and enchantment. Its cobblestone lanes wind and intertwine, with winding paths and low walls dotted with flowers. The houses on either side, arranged with pleasing irregularity, combine white walls and red roof tiles with sea-like blue and earthy ochre to form the town's dominant palette, lending a sense of natural, simple, unhurried ease and pleasure. Wandering through at will, one takes in the ingenious little craft shops, the colorful arrangements on the walls, the elegant street lamps, and the fragrance of chocolate and strawberry liqueur, all evoking a quiet, detached contentment. The alleys are secluded and enduring, with poetry and beauty quietly appearing at every turn. The white walls and bell tower of the Church of Santa Maria, with their Baroque ornamentation, exude classical grace and refinement. The old town's terrain rises and falls, its winding paths like a beautiful melody extending up into the hills and along the town walls. Climbing the walls and looking out in every direction, on one side rows of red-tiled roofs stretch out with vineyards fading into a hazy green horizon, while on the other side the town walls curve away in parallel lines, disappearing into misty rain as quietly as a page from history. Wandering back and forth here, one feels, without quite noticing it, the contented ease of 'walking to where the water ends, then sitting to watch the clouds rise.'

flow.caption_zh: 奧比多斯小鎮坐落在山頂上，完全被堅固的城牆環繞著。它是中世紀建築保存完好的典範，其蜿蜒的街道、迷人的廣場、宏偉的城牆和歷史悠久的城堡都是熱門的旅遊景點。城堡本身已被改建為一家精品酒店（pousada），提供獨特的住宿體驗。（攝影/何康隆）
巷弄清幽，偶有詩意和美學悄然迎面而來。（攝影/何康隆）
這座教堂被認為是小鎮的第一座教堂，建於一座神廟的遺址之上，該神廟後來被改建為清真寺。儘管教堂的建造始於12世紀，但它經歷了多次修復，如今其大部分建築都呈現文藝復興風格。這座教堂在1444年聲名鵲起，當時年僅10歲的阿方索五世國王在此迎娶了他8歲的表妹伊莎貝爾。   （攝影/何康隆）
